summary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The v2 candidate answers the live DR-133 acceptance cell obligation-by-obligation without claiming standing. It pins and preserves file 01's general closed boundary while recording an expressly preview-role-scoped narrowing: the TypeScript provider's semantic products are facts and Coverage, while declared requirements, capability negotiation, fact provenance, typed fault/cancellation detail, and fact/Coverage commitments continue through their existing protocol frames. Findings are produced only by host-owned rules over admitted facts. The refusal predicate is now total rather than enumeration-triggered, names the previously omitted policy and Coverage mutations, and leaves D9 selection with the existing DELIVERY-to-D9 provider-protocol mapping. The retained finding attacks are constructible on the effective closed TypeScript wire: an unknown Finding frame, an unknown member on a closed payload, and a provider-minted or mismatched FactCandidateV1 relation/schema. Each rejects before semantic admission and no provider value is reinterpreted as a Finding. The candidate invents no wire type, D9 value, identity recipe, pack, product boundary, SATISFIED disposition, seal, or implementation grant. DR-133 remains OPEN and this verdict is review evidence only.
